description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): a second test suite must be wired into test (both binaries run), AND install must depend on test (not just all) - make install must never stage an unverified build
prompts: Add tests/test_strutil.c (assert-based, exercising strutil_trim on leading-only, trailing-only, and all-whitespace input, printing PASS at the end - same style as the existing tests/test_calc.c). In the Makefile, rename the existing `TEST_SRCS`/`TEST_TARGET` to `TEST_CALC_SRCS`/`TEST_CALC_TARGET` and add matching `TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS`/`TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET` plus a build rule for the new binary. Update the `test` target's prerequisites AND recipe so `make test` builds and runs BOTH test binaries. Add an `install` target that stages the built binary at `stage/app` - but critically, `install` must depend on `test` (not just `all`), so a clean `make install` actually runs BOTH test suites before staging anything. An unverified build - one where the tests were never run - must never make it into `stage/`.

test_setup_files.check_install_runs_tests.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'clean'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make clean failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'install'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make install failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

assert Path('stage/app').exists(), 'make install did not stage bin/app to stage/app'

assert r.stdout.count('PASS') >= 2, (
    f"expected 'make install' to run BOTH test suites before staging (2 PASS lines), got: "
    f'{r.stdout!r} - install must depend on test, not just all, so an unverified build can never '
    f'be staged')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

STAGEDIR := stage
STAGED_TARGET := $(STAGEDIR)/app

TEST_CALC_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_CALC_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_strutil.c
TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_strutil

.PHONY: all clean test install

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

$(STAGEDIR):
	mkdir -p $(STAGEDIR)

install: $(TARGET) test | $(STAGEDIR)
	cp $(TARGET) $(STAGED_TARGET)

test: $(TEST_CALC_TARGET) $(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_CALC_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)

$(TEST_CALC_TARGET): $(TEST_CALC_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_CALC_SRCS) -o $(TEST_CALC_TARGET)

$(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET): $(TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_STRUTIL_SRCS) -o $(TEST_STRUTIL_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(STAGEDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
